env.name: IVN_LIBRARY_APP
env.about: Your app's id in the App library, in lower case with underscores: for the prefix ACME PTS, acme_pts. Each shop that installs your app connects with a key that names this id.
env.purpose: Your app's id in the App library, like acme_pts for the prefix ACME PTS

env.name: POC_PREFIX
env.about: The prefix of the field that holds the purchase order's number in the shop, in lower case: for the prefix ACME POC, acme_poc (the field acme_poc_erp_number).
env.purpose: Filled in for you: the prefix of the field that holds the purchase order's number, like acme_poc
